Blocks.Text: Upon completing development, to ensure official certification of LinkedIn Recruiter System Connect, review each of the test cases in every certification module.
Before scheduling your certification demo, ensure your integration meets the RSC data quality requirements. If any metric falls below the expected threshold, you must resolve it before proceeding.
Similar to development modules, we have defined 7 certification modules. These describe all the test cases that have to be demoed to LinkedIn for a partner or customer to get certified.

Module 1 Certification - Configure Customer Applications and ATS Integrations
Module 2 Certification - Sync Data from ATS to LinkedIn
Module 3 Certification - Retrieve Data from LinkedIn
Module 4 Certification - Sync ACLs
Module 5 Certification - Data Deletion
Module 6 Certification - Other
Module 7 Certification - Job Posting to Job Requisition Migration
Module 1 and Module 7 Certification demos are applicable for partners' ATS only. Certification demo for remaining modules is applicable for both partners and customers.
Each test case in Modules 1 through 6 has a unique rule ID that follows this scheme:

M — the certification module number
SS — the section number within the module, zero-padded to two digits, such as 01 or 02
NNN — a sequential number within that section, zero-padded to three digits, such as 001 or 002

Within a section, test cases are ordered functional, then quantitative, then qualitative, then charter. The check type appears below the rule ID in each test case rather than encoded in the rule ID. Each module page lists its own sections in a rule ID mapping table.
Module 7 uses the same three-column table format but a different rule ID scheme that encodes the check type. Refer to Module 7 certification.

Blocks.Text: Run each test case yourself, then demonstrate it to a LinkedIn reviewer. Test cases in Modules 1 through 6 include the following columns:

Rows.Text: The unique rule ID and the check type. Refer to Check types.
A short scenario heading followed by the ordered actions you perform to demonstrate the behavior. Any conditions that apply to the test appear before the steps.
What must be true after the steps run.

Blocks.Text: References shared by multiple test cases appear under Related documentation headings for the module or section. Test-specific references appear in the expected result cells.
Modules 1 through 6 use the subset of check types that applies to each module. The module page states which ones.

Rows.Text: A test of your integration's behavior that you demonstrate to LinkedIn—create, update, sync, configuration, and authentication flows—and how they appear in LinkedIn Recruiter, plus any required deliverable, such as a data-model mapping or written approval from business development.
An entity count-parity check between your test tenant and LinkedIn.
A data-quality check against the beta-exit data quality thresholds.
A re-run of the applicable functional, quantitative, and qualitative checks on charter customer tenants, as a beta gate.
A trust and safety or legal review that LinkedIn must sign off on before certification.

Blocks.Text:
The Certification Demo can be scheduled with your LinkedIn Business Development point of contact in any order of the above modules as and when development and testing is complete.
In the demo, all the module-specific test cases should be covered. If few test cases are not applicable for your integration, call them out and notify proactively if possible to your business development point of contact.
LinkedIn will certify based on the complete coverage of test cases in the certification demos.
Upon successful certification, LinkedIn will provision your Production API Key
